info.title: UniPass independent RP/BFF sample
info.description: RP origin endpoints, distinct from IAM. Browser writes require exact Origin and CSRF; back-channel logout uses a signed JWT and replay protection. Bearer credentials never appear in BFF responses.

200.description: Process readiness, not full IAM dependency acceptance

get.description: Revalidates the current access token against IAM; returns sub and application only.

409.description: Concurrent session request; retry after one second

503.description: Dependency unavailable; no protected data returned

get.description: Calls the RP resource API using a server-held token; browser receives application data only.

409.description: Concurrent session request; retry after one second

503.description: Dependency unavailable; no protected data returned

get.description: Requires own client/audience, at+jwt, api.read and current IAM introspection. ID tokens and tokens of another RP are rejected.

409.description: Concurrent session request; retry after one second

503.description: Dependency unavailable; no protected data returned

302.description: Redirects to fixed IAM authorization endpoint with state, nonce and S256 PKCE

get.description: Framework callback; checks saved single-use state, PKCE, ID token and nonce.

302.description: Clears local session and redirects to registered IAM logout with ID token hint

post.description: Server-to-server signed RS256 logout JWT. Requires fixed issuer, own audience, logout+jwt, events, bounded iat/exp, sid and unique jti; optional sub must match bound sessions. No Cookie, Origin or CSRF required. Query parameters are rejected. sid is mandatory in this registration profile.

200.description: sid revoked and local sessions removed atomically; Cache-Control: no-store

400.description: Missing, invalid, mismatched, duplicate or replayed notification

503.description: Signature key or session store unavailable; no success confirmation
